description: Portable rclone GUI: browse, transfer and sync files on Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox, S3 and 70+ other cloud services.
pre_install: $names = 'tasks.bin', 'mirrors.json', 'mirror_history.json'; foreach ($n in $names) { if (!(Test-Path "$persist_dir\$n")) { $old = Get-ChildItem (Split-Path $dir) -Directory | Where-Object { $_.FullName -ne $dir -and $_.Name -ne 'current' -and (Test-Path (Join-Path $_.FullName $n)) } | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 1; if ($old) { Copy-Item (Join-Path $old.FullName $n) "$dir\$n" } else { New-Item "$dir\$n" -ItemType File | Out-Null } } }
